result.reasoning: This commit introduced the getSession() method in CourseEvent.java, which directly calls getRelatedCourses().iterator (implicitly via the for-each loop) without checking for null. The fix commit adds a null check (`if (getRelatedCourses() == null) return null;`) at the start of this exact method, directly addressing the NullPointerException scenario when getRelatedCourses() is null (e.g., during course-related event creation before it's fully populated). The method did not exist before this commit, so this is the exact origin of the bug.
